launches.name: Jinx
launches.lore: Jinx is a black cat found in mid-October 2018, three or four weeks old, in a field behind her owner Mia's California home.

cat.name: Jinx
cat.owner: Mia Ibanez ('mii', @mibajinx), who runs @bigfootjinx on X, Instagram and TikTok
cat.story: Jinx is a black cat found in mid-October 2018, three or four weeks old, in a field behind her owner Mia's California home. Her name comes from the strange coincidences that led to finding her near Halloween. The vet said she is 'special', with some birth defects: an underbite from a very small jaw, big eyes and very big feet. Mia says she is completely healthy. Posts on Instagram, TikTok and X (@bigfootjinx) won her a cult following as a meme reaction image. In April 2022 Mia bought two square feet of Scottish land to make her a 'lady of Scotland', then paid for her to be mayor of Hell, Michigan for one day, 24 April 2022: Hell's first pet mayor (USA Today). Her proclamations included National Jinx Day, one Jinx mural per mile, a statue in her honour and a ban on all eggs. She was impeached that day after telling the town to steal catfish from the next town over.
cat.look: Small, solid jet-black short-haired female with a round little face and huge, bulging eyes. Her pupils are very large and dilated, ringed by a thin gold-yellow iris that shows as amber-gold when the pupils narrow. Big upright ears. Tiny muzzle with a slight underbite, often with a pink tongue tip showing. Oversized paws and big feet. Compact body with a small white patch on the lower belly by one hind leg.

launches.name: Hoi-chan
launches.lore: Hoi-chan (full name ホイップクリーム, 'Whipped Cream') is the clingy cat of HOIPPU_0722, where her manga-loving owner 'Hoi-nushi' posts their everyday life.

cat.name: Hoi-chan
cat.owner: ホイ主 ('Hoi-nushi'), her manga-loving owner, who runs @HOIPPU_0722
cat.story: Hoi-chan (full name ホイップクリーム, 'Whipped Cream') is the clingy cat of @HOIPPU_0722, where her manga-loving owner 'Hoi-nushi' posts their everyday life. The bio jokingly gives her breed as 'Whippish Whipfold' (ホイティッシュホイルド) with a 'chikuwa pattern'. On her 10th birthday in July 2025 fans sent her into X trends, and the owner posted 'I-it's trending...! Thank you for putting up with 10 years of me showing off my cat.' Her October 2025 post, about her coming downstairs sleepy-eyed while breakfast is made, reached 35.5k likes. The cat exhibition ねこ休み展 gave her a spin-off show, 'Marugoto Hoi-chan Exhibition in Shizuoka' (Shizuoka Parco, 7-23 Sep 2019), and her bio links two LINE sticker sets.
cat.look: A fluffy, plush white cat with pale cream (dilute ginger) patches: a cream cap over the crown and both ears, a cream mask around and above each eye split by a white forehead blaze, and light cream smudges on the cheeks beside the pink nose. Big round amber-gold eyes, pink toe beans, a round face, a soft chunky build. Small, wide-set, round-tipped ears with pink insides sit up, unfolded. Everyday: a dark beaded collar with a small round charm, sometimes a pink bow with a gold 'LOVE' bell. 10th birthday: a crocheted pale-yellow party hat with a blue pompom and a pastel crocheted ruff.

launches.name: Fishtopher
launches.lore: Fishtopher was a 5-year-old stray at Homeward Bound Pet Adoption Center in Blackwood, New Jersey.

cat.name: Fishtopher
cat.owner: Laura Folts and Tanner Callahan, who adopted him; Folts created @mrfishtopher
cat.story: Fishtopher was a 5-year-old stray at Homeward Bound Pet Adoption Center in Blackwood, New Jersey. His Petfinder listing said he was 'very sad and depressed', would only eat when he had company and 'wouldn't even look up for pictures'. On 24 Nov 2022 @mollyaclarke tweeted 'i swear to god. if one of you doesn't go get fishtopher…', and the post went viral (over 168,000 likes and 21,000 retweets, per NBC News). Laura Folts and Tanner Callahan drove two hours from Baltimore and were first in line to adopt him, and the shelter said 16 other animals were adopted that weekend. His own account, @mrfishtopher ('FIV+ internet cat, animal rescue fan'), shares photos of him at home with his cat friends and promotes other rescues.
cat.look: A big-cheeked brown classic tabby. His warm grey-brown coat has bold black marbled swirls on the flanks and back (his shelter listing said he 'reminds you of a Bengal with his cool coloring'), black stripes and an 'M' on the forehead, striped legs and a dark tail. Green-yellow eyes with droopy, heavy lids gave him his famous sad look. Brick-pink nose, pale chin, long white whiskers and a stocky, heavy build. In recent home photos he looks alert and relaxed beside a black cat and an orange-and-white cat.

launches.name: Bugcat Capoo
launches.lore: Bugcat Capoo (貓貓蟲咖波, Māomāochóng Kābō) is a chubby blue cat with six legs, created in 2014 by the Taiwanese artist Yara (亞拉).

cat.name: Bugcat Capoo
cat.owner: Yara (亞拉), Taiwanese artist; official X account @bugcat_capoo_tw
cat.story: Bugcat Capoo (貓貓蟲咖波, Māomāochóng Kābō) is a chubby blue cat with six legs, created in 2014 by the Taiwanese artist Yara (亞拉). His official description: "a little monster like a cat and like a bug, both violent and cute, who loves to eat meat". He is always hungry for meat, dislikes vegetables, and lives with his owner Lala and the dog Dogdog. Capoo began as an amateur strip on the Taiwanese site Bahamut. A set of 40 LINE stickers followed in October 2014. After winning the short-comic category of the 2015 WEBTOON Original Comic Competition, he ran as a LINE WEBTOON comic until March 2020. Marking his 12th birthday, @bugcat_capoo_tw posted on 19 May 2026 in Yara's own voice: "I've been drawing Capoo for 12 years now" and "I'll keep drawing ... until Capoo reaches Mars!"
cat.look: Drawn character in a flat cartoon style with thick dark outlines. A chubby, gumdrop-shaped sky-blue body on four short stubby legs like a real cat, with two small pointed triangular cat ears. A large white oval belly patch runs from chest to base. A row of darker-blue rounded scale bumps runs down the edge of his back: the 'bug' part. Small black oval dot eyes spaced wide apart, and a tiny cat 'ω' mouth that opens into a red-pink mouth when he is happy. He wears no accessories. In the official 7-ELEVEN Taichung video, a giant blue Capoo plush sits with a yellow chick on its head.

launches.name: Blue Cat
launches.lore: Blue Cat is the lead character of Cool Cats, created by artist Colin 'Clon' Egan in 2013.

cat.name: Blue Cat
cat.owner: Cool Cats Group (Cool Cats brand); created by artist Clon (Colin Egan), whose X bio now reads 'Prev: @coolcats'
cat.story: Blue Cat is the lead character of Cool Cats, created by artist Colin 'Clon' Egan in 2013. Cool Cats began as a series of artworks by the 'Catoonist' and moved to Instagram in 2015. In 2021 Clon launched the Cool Cats NFT collection of 9,999 hand-illustrated Blue Cat PFPs, and days later Mike Tyson changed his Twitter profile picture to a Cool Cat. In 2023 Cool Cats won a Macy's online contest among five NFT brands, and Blue Cat and his milk-carton friend Chugs became a giant balloon in the 97th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, launched alongside the YouTube series 'The Milk Chug'. On X, @coolcats keeps his lore going: a 'Clontest' challenging fans to draw Blue Cat faster than Clon (head, face, t-shirt and peace-sign hand required), a Friday-the-13th post of Blue Cat hoping for luck with a special red bird, and his cameo in the OP3N game universe.
cat.look: Flat hand-drawn cartoon with thick black marker outlines. An all-over sky-blue cat with no markings, on all four legs like a real cat. Big rounded head, two rounded, slightly pointed ears, small white oval eyes with black vertical pupils, a black oval open mouth (pink tongue in his avatar) and two or three short whisker strokes per cheek. Yellow short-sleeved t-shirt with a white/cream square chest patch, dark green trousers on his hind legs, one front paw raised in a peace sign. Macy's art adds a white cap with a blue brim and orange button, and black wraparound sunglasses.

cat.name: Milly
cat.owner: fatfatmillycat (Milly's owner; @fatfatmillycat on X and Instagram)
cat.story: Milly is the original 'BLEHHHHH :P' cat. Her owner's Instagram, fatfatmillycat, posted her tongue-out photo on 23 July 2022, and on 5 Aug 2022 posted the first meme of it, captioned 'i can act rather silly at times'. On 24 Aug 2022 @vampiric_shirin posted the photo on X as a kid refusing homework: 'BLEHHHHH :P i am NOT doing that u can't make me'. Know Your Meme says that post started the 'I Am Not Doing That Cat' format, and that the photo helped launch the 2022 Silly Cats trend. Her own X bio reads 'milly the “bleh” cat, certified panko clone', and her posts often show her on a black ping-pong table ('The sniffer is back on the ping pong table'). Her official Linktree links a Milly merch shop.
cat.look: Chunky white dilute calico with short plush fur. Face, chest, belly and legs are mostly white. A pale ginger-orange and soft grey cap covers the crown and ears, with more orange over one ear. Cream-orange patches on the back and flanks, and a round smoky-grey spot on the front of one shoulder and upper leg. Pink nose. Pale green-hazel eyes, often squeezed shut. Her signature pose is a long pink tongue stuck out at the camera. She often sits on a black ping-pong table with red paddles, and once wore a rainbow-striped bandana.

launches.name: Rolf
launches.lore: Rolf is the University of Warwick's campus cat; Wikipedia's Warwick article says the university 'has a campus cat named Rolf'.

cat.name: Rolf
cat.owner: Helen Bevan, Robb Corrigan and family (live near the University of Warwick campus)
cat.story: Rolf is the University of Warwick's campus cat; Wikipedia's Warwick article says the university 'has a campus cat named Rolf'. He lives with his family (Helen Bevan, Robb Corrigan and family) near campus and calls himself an 'Ambassacat for student health & wellbeing', with #RelaxWithRolf on Fridays. His X account was set up to track his movements across campus and tell students where to find him for a quick meet-up (The Boar). On 7 March 2021 hackers took over the account and replaced his daily updates with posts including a protest about bitcoin. The #CatsOfTwitter community let fans know he was safe, and Twitter support returned the account that Sunday night. Students have called for him to get an honorary degree. His daily 'Rolf report' still runs: posing with his staff ID card for the Exam Team, or being carried round the uni by his 'American Human' with all four paws dangling.
cat.look: Sleek solid-black short-haired cat with golden-amber eyes, upright pointed ears and a slim, long body (he calls himself 'quite a long cat'); black paws. He wears a yellow reflective collar, and on duty a yellow hi-vis vest printed 'CAMPUS CAT'; his humans hold up his small staff ID card, which has his photo on it.

proof.author: RolfatWarwick
proof.text: Rolf report 5 Aug: This is how my American Human typically totes me about the uni. I don’t mind this at all. Yes all 4 paws are dangling, but that means I can easily spring into action if required. Plus he has a free paw himself - to feed me treats of course, as and when. Rolf x

launches.name: Ponta
launches.lore: Ponta, one of the Catcoin Sanctuary's cats.

cat.name: Ponta
cat.story: Ponta (ぽんた) is the real male mixed-breed cat of manga diarist Tsuyoshi Konoike (@TsuyoshiWood). He stars in the one-page diary comics that made Konoike's following explode on Twitter. A friend found him as an abandoned kitten and pushed Konoike to take him, and his old name 'Nonta' became Ponta. He won't warm to strangers at all and scratches his owner often. His housemate Alfred, found hurt in the bushes behind the house, is gentle. The comics became the book series 鴻池剛と猫のぽんた ニャアアアン! (Kadokawa/Enterbrain, vol. 1 Oct 2015, vol. 4 Feb 2026) and two LINE sticker sets. Konoike's site marked Ponta's 14th birthday on 15 Sep 2025. In a 26 Aug 2026 comic his vet marvels that he gained 100 g and still runs and jumps despite long-term kidney disease, and then, held by the nurses for an ear cleaning, Ponta lands a swat on a hand.
cat.look: As drawn in Konoike's bold, clean manga style with flat colour: a big, round, heavy-set, thick-furred cat. His back, head and tail are a warm caramel-brown. A white blaze runs down the middle of the face and widens into a white muzzle, and his chest, belly and paws are white. Small rounded ears and narrow, half-lidded glaring eyes give him a permanently grumpy, unimpressed face. In the 2023 surgery comics he wears a pink cone collar. Konoike says the real cat (a brown tabby-and-white) looks quite different from the simplified drawing, so follow the comic design.
